notes: Unit handling: Kimberly-Clark 10-K reports key figures in millions; all historical monetary amounts are converted to full USD units (multiply by 1,000,000). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/55785/000162828026007567/kmb-20251231.htm))

EBIT definition: using Operating Profit from the consolidated statements of income (continuing operations) as the EBIT proxy. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/55785/000162828026007567/kmb-20251231.htm))

D&A and capex definition: D&A uses total depreciation and amortization expense excluding discontinued operations; capex uses total capital spending excluding discontinued operations. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/55785/000162828026007567/kmb-20251231.htm))

NWC construction (forecast + 2024/2025): NWC = (Accounts receivable + Inventories + Other current assets) - (Trade accounts payable + Accrued expenses and other current liabilities), excluding cash and excluding dividends payable; calculated on continuing-operations balance-sheet presentation at each year-end. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/55785/000162828026007567/kmb-20251231.htm))

NWC 2023 is set to null: company reporting basis shifts around the IFP transaction (discontinued vs continuing) complicate constructing a consistent continuing-operations NWC for 2023 with the provided year-end balance-sheet disclosures. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/55785/000162828026007567/kmb-20251231.htm))

Tax rate: base-case uses ~23% aligned to management’s stated adjusted effective tax rate outlook for 2026. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/55785/000162828026003514/kmb2025q48kex-991.htm))

WACC: set using an external discount-rate summary (guessed/proxy in absence of a primary-source WACC); validate with your model’s own capital structure and CAPM inputs. ([gurufocus.com](https://www.gurufocus.com/term/wacc/KMB?utm_source=openai))

Peer comps: EV/NTM revenue and EV/NTM EBITDA are left null because NTM-specific EV multiples were not reliably sourced from primary/high-quality sources in this pass; P/E values (where provided) come from the finance tool and may not be strictly NTM.
Current price: 98.2 as of the finance tool’s latest trade timestamp on 2026-03-21 UTC.

NOL balance: set to 1.1B based on disclosed income tax loss carryforwards included in deferred tax assets language (not a standalone company-specific 'US NOL' field). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/55785/000162828026007567/kmb-20251231.htm))

catalysts: IFP transaction closing in mid-2026 (timing and financial presentation impact). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/55785/000162828026007567/kmb-20251231.htm))

Kenvue acquisition closing in the second half of 2026 and integration execution driving incremental operating leverage and synergy capture. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/55785/000162828026007567/kmb-20251231.htm))
Transformation initiative completion and associated margin/cash flow improvements into 2027–2028. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/55785/000162828026007567/kmb-20251231.htm))
company_overview: Kimberly-Clark is a global personal care manufacturer with major brands across categories including Huggies, Kleenex, Scott, Kotex, Poise, and Depend. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/55785/000162828026003514/kmb2025q48kex-991.htm))

The company operates in more than 175 countries and territories and reports continuing operations primarily through North America and International Personal Care. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/55785/000162828026003514/kmb2025q48kex-991.htm))

Management is progressing a multi-year transformation initiative and has disclosed an upcoming transaction (IFP) and planned acquisition (Kenvue). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/55785/000162828026007567/kmb-20251231.htm))
current_context: FY 2025 (continuing ops) net sales were $16.4B (down 2.1%); operating profit was $2.4B, with organic sales growth of 1.7%. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/55785/000162828026003514/kmb2025q48kex-991.htm))

2026 Outlook: organic sales expected to be in line with or ahead of ~2% weighted global category growth; adjusted operating profit expected to grow mid- to high-single digits on a constant-currency basis; adjusted EPS from continuing operations expected to grow double digit with adjusted effective tax rate ~23%. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/55785/000162828026003514/kmb2025q48kex-991.htm))

Disclosed timeline items include expected IFP transaction closing mid-2026 and Kenvue acquisition completion expected in the second half of 2026. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/55785/000162828026007567/kmb-20251231.htm))
investment_highlights: Base-case reported revenue growth is set modestly above/near low-single digits (2026–2030) consistent with management’s 2026 organic growth framing (~2% category growth) plus modest reported headwinds. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/55785/000162828026003514/kmb2025q48kex-991.htm))

EBIT margin recovery is modeled from the depressed 2025 GAAP operating margin level toward a normalized mid/upper-teens margin by 2030, reflecting ongoing transformation progress and cost discipline. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/55785/000162828026003514/kmb2025q48kex-991.htm))

D&A and capex intensities are forecast to normalize from the elevated 2025 capex level (transformation/investment cycle) toward more stable long-run ratios. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/55785/000162828026007567/kmb-20251231.htm))

Working capital is modeled with persistently negative NWC (payables > receivables/inventory), consistent with historical balance-sheet structure. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/55785/000162828026007567/kmb-20251231.htm))
key_risks: Transformation execution risk: margin recovery may lag due to unfavorable pricing vs. input costs, or higher than expected structural costs. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/55785/000162828026003514/kmb2025q48kex-991.htm))

External risk: currency translation and commodity/input cost volatility could pressure reported results even if organic performance remains stable. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/55785/000162828026007567/kmb-20251231.htm))

Tax/regulatory risk: changes in tax assumptions (including valuation allowances) can affect effective tax rate and net income timing. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/55785/000162828026007567/kmb-20251231.htm))

valuation_summary: The DCF base case is anchored to last-reported GAAP continuing-operations revenue/operating profit and then transitions to normalized margin and capital intensity assumptions over 2026–2030. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/55785/000162828026007567/kmb-20251231.htm))
Terminal value uses an exit EBITDA multiple approach (terminal_method=exit_multiple) with conservative modest upside/downside in bull/bear via the terminal multiple and margin targets.
Peer comps are provided primarily as cross-checks (P/E sourced where available; EV/NTM multiples left null where not directly sourced at NTM granularity).
